propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeTelephonyExchange
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a telephony exchange. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type TELEPHONYEXCHANGE.

properties.name: UserCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the user capacity of the device, defined as the maximum number of users that can be active at the same time.
